title: 10 at Once!? Watch me Break ChatGPT Operator
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
I tried ChatGPT's new $200/month operator plan by pushing it to run 10 operators simultaneously across different tabs. I tested real-life business scenarios such as finding underpriced items on OfferUp and Craigslist, scraping Amazon reviews, and tracking Google Flights. I also had it search for Airbnb deals, extract emails from Chamber of Commerce lists, and analyze Etsy trends to find Chinese manufacturers. The operators even attempted to locate an iPhone 15 on Facebook, watch Instagram reels, and create a business plan using ChatGPT. The AI solved captcha, logged data to Google Sheets, and performed reverse image searches & more.
